info.title: Permission-Aware Enterprise Knowledge System
info.description: Answers questions from company documents, using only the documents the person asking may read. Sign in at `/auth/login` and send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Every error has the same body, `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`. Any route may also answer 405 for the wrong method, 411 or 413 for a body without a length or over the limit, and 500 with the request ID. The whole description, with the reasons behind it, is docs/api.md.

get.description: Answers once the embedding model and the index are loaded. Needs no token, so it says nothing else: no version, no model, no counts.

post.description: An email and password for a bearer token, which holds only the user's ID, its expiry and the user's token version. Every failed login gets the same 401. Recorded in the audit trail, whether it succeeds or not.

401.description: Wrong email or password, or an account that is no longer active: the same body for each.

422.description: The body, a parameter or the path isn't what the route takes, or breaks one of its rules. `fields` says where, and nothing that was sent is repeated.

429.description: Too many failed logins for this email. `Retry-After` says how many seconds to wait; until then even the right password is refused.

503.description: The request, or its refusal, couldn't be recorded in the audit trail, so it wasn't done.

Classification.title: Classification
Classification.description:
Who a document is for.

GENERAL       everyone who can use the assistant
DEPARTMENTAL  members of the owning department, and executives
RESTRICTED    only people named in a grant, whatever their role

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Only for a request that doesn't match the route: where, never what was sent.
